chronology: Post-outcome reporting supplement selected after the complete v2 analysis and post-merge PR84 review were inspected. V2 used 199 all-eight-finite paired score vectors; the missing vector may still contain usable Brier coordinates. This is additional reporting under a new version, not a prospective analysis or a replacement of v1/v2.
limitations: Conditional working-model sampling uncertainty only; successful finite subsets must be explicit. Does not include source identity/clock/unit ambiguity, treatment, informative observation/stopping, model structure, transport or causal uncertainty. The reporting estimands were selected after v2 outcomes were seen.

summary_policy.complete_vector: Preserve the original eight-coordinate covariance/percentiles conditional on every coordinate being finite; do not relabel it as unconditional metric-specific uncertainty.
summary_policy.coordinate: Each coordinate uses every finite value for that coordinate from a successful primary fit and valid paired evaluation. Report total, finite and unavailable counts and nominal contributing-draw resolution; a nonfinite value in another coordinate cannot remove it.
summary_policy.insufficient_support: Fewer than two contributing vectors gives unavailable covariance/percentiles, with counts retained.
summary_policy.metric_blocks: Separate four-coordinate log-score and four-coordinate Brier covariance/percentiles on draws complete for that block. Do not combine entries calculated on different supports into one joint covariance.
summary_policy.publication: Retain identifier-free aggregate bootstrap score vectors with finite/null statuses for offline reconstruction. These are model score differences, not participant predictions, labels, assays, time coordinates, allocation hashes or source rows.
summary_policy.reconciliation: Same-platform replay must exactly reproduce original complete-vector and rate summaries, coordinate order, settings, and selection. Failure to reconcile prevents publication; no rate or uncertainty result is silently substituted.
summary_policy.unsupported_log_scores: Keep unavailable/nonfinite log differences explicit. No probability floors, replacing infinity with zero, redraws or extrapolation. Legacy differences do not distinguish all causes, so do not infer that an unavailable difference is a numerical fit failure.

unchanged: Source pins/acquisition, exact selection/allocation, first-observation/available-time conditioning, primary CTMC and IID fitting, six starts, rates/caps/scaling/optimizer tolerances, 200 whole-label resamples, seed 20261001, quantile levels 0.025/0.5/0.975, failed draws retained without replacement, and all scientific/engine gates remain unchanged. Replay only the existing bootstrap; do not refit full-data models or profiles.
